systems.country_label: Plataforma online para a Gestão escolar
systems.tiers: designed in 2018 and implemented from 2019 as a pilot in all districts; supervisors collect information on the attendance of heads, teachers and pupils, on school councils, on school management and on learning; MINEDH follows the supervised districts
schools, yearly on 3 March; cited for textbook counts in 2019

note: No fact: the online platform is filled by supervisors on their visits, not by schools, and no per-learner record is described, so it is a supervision tool, class single-function, whatever its name. MINEDH told the review of 25 May 2020 that it is hard to use online and that it is working on that.
